verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents training the agent on your brand guidelines, which is a direct, first-party way to set brand voice. Coach's Ticket Quality Score, which reviews 100% of conversations against your quality standards, offers some indirect support for keeping that voice consistent. The tone-control mechanism itself is described only in a single thin line. missing for 10: explicit tone/voice configuration controls, any evidence of consistency across languages, documented enforcement of voice consistency across topics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I control the agent's tone and brand voice, and it stays consistent across topics and languages
